source: Held-out requests (2026-10-10). Built from the hand-judged sentences of an independent review of the parser (about 240 parser requests and 160 end-to-end requests; their intended meanings were re-read and only the certain ones kept), the scenarios of each defect that review reported (every phrasing it quoted), and slice 'realistic': requests written by the parser's implementer BEFORE reading what the parser answered. A case with `sequence` is what parse_all must return, in order; a case without is the first request (parse). Optional checks per request: exclude, facing, facing_away, shape, seats, every, rows, cols, unknown_verb, truncated, notes_contain, unknown; an item may have count null (any) or count_min. Slices selfcorrect, undo_forms, unplaced_object, chat_retraction, colour_one, hypothetical, modal_requests, past_purpose, toss_chuck, casual_clear, leading_no, apostrophes, fewer_less, neg_scope, chat_words, bare_plural_remove, reference_prep, side_of and opinions (2026-10-10, P0 parser classes) were written from the MEANING of each sentence before the parser's answer was read, 33-52 sentences per class, and each is required at 100%. Extra checks there: times (an undo repeated N times), inert (does nothing), noreal (builds no library thing, destroys nothing).
